name: Digital Product Passport (UNTP)
description: UN Transparency Protocol 0.7.0 Digital Product Passport: a product or batch, its identifiers, category, origin and performance claims, published by its producer.
summary: Credential type template for the UNTP 0.7.0 DigitalProductPassport, a W3C VCDM 2.0 credential (jwt_vc_vcdm) with the UNTP context and schema. It is issued with no holder and published as a "dpp" link in the issuer's did:web DID document (untpLinkType), as in workflows/dpp-workflow.md. The form covers the Product: identifiers, identifier scheme, category, facility and country of production. Performance claims, whose evidence links the DCCs behind them, are nested deeper than the form describes. Issued by the noop/dpp_supplier and noop/dpp_manufacturer wallet templates.
